acip: 'KHOR LO SNGA MA LTAR NA PHYI NANG GNYIS KYI RTZIBS BCU DRUG ,RANG LUGS THUN MONG MIN PAR 'KHOR LO'I RTZIBS BRGYAD DANG NOR BU'I GZHOGS KHA BRGYAD BSDOMS PAS BCU DRUG ,RDO RJE NAG PO'I PHRENG BA PHYI NANG GNYIS BSDOMS PA BCU DRUG STE KHYON SUM CU SO GNYIS KYIS SPYI BO'I RTZA 'DAB SUM CU SO GNYIS MTSON, 'KHOR LOS DBU SKRA MI SGRIB PA DANG, DBU SKRAS 'KHOR LO MI SGRIB PAR BSGOM DGOS,
wylie: 'khor lo snga ma ltar na phyi nang gnyis kyi rtsibs bcu drug ,rang lugs thun mong min par 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad dang nor bu'i gzhogs kha brgyad bsdoms pas bcu drug ,rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba phyi nang gnyis bsdoms pa bcu drug ste khyon sum cu so gnyis kyis spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis mtshon, 'khor los dbu skra mi sgrib pa dang, dbu skras 'khor lo mi sgrib par bsgom dgos
english: Each spoke of the circular headdress, as we spoke of above, has an inner and outer section, totaling then 16 pieces.  In our own system though we have a unique way of arriving at this number 16, by adding together the eight spokes of the wheel and the eight facets of the jewels at the top.  We then add another 16 for the two strings of black diamonds, inside and out, which brings us to a total of 32.  This represents the 32 petals of the chakra at the center tip of the head.  In your meditation don't let the headdress block Her hair, nor Her hair block the headdress.
